  │Command palette                                                                                                   │  
  │                                                                                                                  │  
  │filter:                                                                                                           │  
  │❯ Models  go to the Models tab                                                                                    │  
  │  Agent  go to the Agent tab                                                                                      │  
  │  Settings  go to the Settings tab                                                                                │  
  │  Change model  open the Agent model picker                                                                       │  
  │  Clear conversation  wipe the Agent transcript (asks first)                                                      │  
  │  Copy last reply  copy the latest agent reply via OSC 52 (enable in Settings)                                    │  
  │  Undo last change  revert the agent's last file change (asks first)                                              │  
  │  Redo last undo  reapply the last undone change (asks first)                                                     │  
  │  Toggle theme  switch dark ↔ light for this session                                                              │  
  │  Refresh models  reload the model list                                                                           │  
  │  Logs drawer  toggle the debug log drawer (ctrl+o)                                                               │  
  │  Command list  open the slash-command reference                                                                  │  
  │type to filter · ↑/↓ or j/k move · enter run · esc close                                                          │
